mutations_proposed.rationale: lower threshold to break stagnation by accepting slightly weaker signals, increasing trade frequency while sharpe buffer allows it
widen take-profit to capture larger directional moves, leveraging the high sharpe ratio to ride winners longer
loosen trailing stop to reduce premature exits on healthy pullbacks, allowing positions to fully develop
